extras: Part of the -osaurus family (Linkosaurus, Scalosaurus). Works on mobile.
intentEvidence: Searchosaurus is Spotlight for your vault.
motivation: The author built it because the built-in search failed to prioritize exact title matches over mentions.
problem: Obsidian's default search often returns mentions or related entries instead of the exact note title the user intended.
summary: A Spotlight-style search tool that ranks notes by relevance, provides live previews, and includes offline OCR for images and PDFs.
